product.name: Linen tea towel
product.description: The towel is linen, hemmed, for drying cups.

blocks.text: The tag on Linen tea towel was $60.82.
The amount to be billed is sixty seven dollars and sixty seven cents.
No packing line is added. Cotton cord at $2.73 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
The shelf card lists nine on hand in the stockroom.

trick.evidence_text: Charged figure sixty seven dollars and sixty seven cents.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is sixty seven dollars and sixty seven cents and the tag was $60.82. Refuse the higher figure.
